name: BeYourCover
description: Designs AI book covers from a title, genre and summary, then edits them, removes cover text, makes square audiobook covers, upscales to print resolution and builds complete Amazon KDP paperback and hardcover wraps with a print-ready PDF. Also lists and downloads the account's books, covers and wraps, and calculates KDP wrap dimensions. OAuth authentication; generation tools need an active BeYourCover API or workspace plan and spend its credits.
author: BeYourCover
